hits.snippet: Aisha Malik Atlas, a 3D generative AI platform, is launching with $6 million in seed funding after two years in stealth. The funding consists of two rounds: a $4.5 million round led by 6th Man Ventures (6MV) and a $1.5 million round led by Collab+Currency. The platform partners with game developers and brands to build virtual worlds in a fraction of the time it takes using traditional methods. Atlas allows developers to generate detailed 3D models from reference images and text. The Vienna-based startup was founded in early 2021 by Ben James, who is a self-taught coder and has a background in architecture. [...] Image Credits: Atlas As for the funding, the startup plans to use it to accelerate the expansion of its suite of developer solutions and the buildout of its self-service 3D AI creator platform. The funding rounds included participation from the a16z Scouting Fund via Shrapnel, Contango, Gaingels, GFR Fund, New Renaissance Ventures, Square Enix and Wagmi Ventures.
